title: Increasing Support for the Sustenance of Livelihoods amongst Performing Arts Workers
what_it_is: Increasing Support for the Sustenance of Livelihoods amongst Performing Arts Workers

sections.label: Arts sector revenue and jobs
sections.summary: The Arts and Entertainment sector earned $6.6 billion in 2017 and provided jobs and livelihoods for 26,300 people in 2018.

sentences.speaker: Ms Carrie Tan (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: The Arts and Entertainment sector generated $6.6 billion in revenue earned in 2017 and provided jobs and livelihoods for 26,300 people in 2018.

sections.label: Falling government arts funding
sections.summary: Government funding for the sector dropped almost 50%, from $937 million in 2015 to $458 million in 2018.

sentences.speaker: Ms Carrie Tan (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: Government funding for the sector has dropped almost 50% from $937 million in 2015 to $458 million in 2018.

sections.label: Permanent casuals and freelancers
sections.summary: Chronic income pressures come from a lack of regulations on permanent casuals, who are among the 47% of freelancers in the sector.

sentences.speaker: Ms Carrie Tan (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: Chronic income pressures on arts workers as well as other workers, come from a lack of regulations on a group of employees called "permanent casuals".

sentences.speaker: Ms Carrie Tan (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: They are among the 47% of freelancers that make up the arts and entertainment sector, higher than the 14% at our national level.

sections.label: JSS support for arts sector
sections.summary: Existing JSS measures provide only 10% of support to the arts and entertainment sector, which cannot return to former operating capacity.

sentences.speaker: Ms Carrie Tan (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: Outside of such workers, existing JSS measures provide only 10% of support to the arts and entertainment sector, even though this sector is still unable to return to its former operating capacity.

sections.label: Digitalisation Fund for G productions
sections.summary: The Digitalisation Fund is a good initiative but is currently available only for productions rated G.

sentences.speaker: Ms Carrie Tan (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: The Digitalisation Fund specifically is also a good initiative in the right direction, but only currently available for productions rated G.

sections.label: Internationalising arts, South Korea example
sections.summary: Missing out on developing the arts sector towards internationalisation would be a mistake, and South Korea's example offers lessons.

sentences.speaker: Ms Carrie Tan (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: It would be a mistake for us to miss out on developing our arts and entertainment sector with a view towards its internationalisation.

sentences.speaker: Ms Carrie Tan (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: We can learn a lot from South Korea's example, whose arts and entertainment industry brought the country S$39.8 billion in 2018.

sections.label: JSS and Digitalisation Fund support
sections.summary: It proposes increasing JSS support for arts workers and permanent casual workers, and broadening Digitalisation Fund eligibility beyond G-rated productions.

sentences.speaker: Ms Carrie Tan (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: In the immediate term, to increase and extend JSS support for arts workers, and income support to permanent casual workers who did not qualify for SIRS.

sentences.speaker: Ms Carrie Tan (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: Two, to broaden the eligibility criteria for the Digitalisation Fund beyond G-rated productions.

sections.label: Arts in inclusive Singapore
sections.summary: It states Singapore includes playwrights, songwriters, painters, poets and storytellers, and that an inclusive economy lets all diverse talent thrive.

sentences.speaker: Ms Carrie Tan (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: Singapore is not just a nation of engineers, scientists, technologists and doctors.

sentences.speaker: Ms Carrie Tan (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: Amongst us are playwrights, songwriters, painters, poets and storytellers.

sentences.speaker: Ms Carrie Tan (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: A truly inclusive economy and future is one that allows all diverse talent to thrive.

sentences.speaker: Ms Carrie Tan (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: To borrow the words from a famous American actress Stella Adler, who founded the Stella Adler Conservatory of Theatre in 1949, and was also teacher to Steve McQueen and Robert DeNiro, "When life beats down and crushes the soul, art reminds you that you have one." Let us not allow our arts sector to languish any further.

sections.label: Arts and heritage funding
sections.summary: It says funding for arts and heritage rose from about $300 million yearly before 2013 to around $450 million yearly from 2016 to 2018.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Low Yen Ling)
sentences.text: Contrary to Ms Tan's suggestion that funding for the arts and heritage fell from 2015 to 2019, I would like to clarify that based on MCCY's annual Singapore Cultural Statistics report, funding for these sectors actually rose from about $300 million per year before 2013, to around $450 million per year from 2016 to 2018.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Low Yen Ling)
sentences.text: In fact, funding was highest in 2014 and 2015 due to the enhanced programming for our SG50 celebrations, as well as major development projects like the revamp of the Asian Civilisations Museum and construction of the National Gallery Singapore.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Low Yen Ling)
sentences.text: I wish to also highlight to Ms Tan and Members that substantial funding was provided to the culture sector through the Government's provision of $350 million to-date for the Cultural Matching Fund or CMF to encourage cultural philanthropy.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Low Yen Ling)
sentences.text: Between 2014 and 2018, the CMF has matched about $215 million worth of donations raised by the sector.

sections.label: ACRP work and training
sections.summary: By end August 2020, ACRP funding generated over 6,000 work and training opportunities and supported more than 900 digitalisation projects and programmes.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Low Yen Ling)
sentences.text: By end August 2020, ACRP funding generated over 6,000 work and training opportunities for arts and culture practitioners and supported more than 900 digitalisation projects and programmes.

sections.label: CDSA training support
sections.summary: The CDSA has supported close to 600 training opportunities, around 300 for freelancers, with a paid training allowance of $10 per hour.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Low Yen Ling)
sentences.text: This grant helps arts and culture organisations and practitioners upskill and prepare for a post-COVID-19 recovery.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Low Yen Ling)
sentences.text: So far, the CDSA has supported close to 600 training opportunities, of which around 300 were for freelancers.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Low Yen Ling)
sentences.text: Those tapping on the CDSA are eligible for paid training allowance of $10 per hour.

sections.label: Digital art form support
sections.summary: It says this support covered over 300 projects and provided around 4,500 work opportunities, about 1,100 for freelancers.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Low Yen Ling)
sentences.text: She spoke passionately about K-pop and actually to a certain extent, I think it is also partly because of their ability to translate their art form into digital medium.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Low Yen Ling)
sentences.text: It has supported over 300 projects and provided around 4,500 work opportunities, of which about 1,100 were for freelancers.

sections.label: Support for arts freelancers
sections.summary: ARH expanded talks and clinics for freelancers, and MCCY and NAC are committed to work opportunities, with national cultural institutions adopting the Tripartite Standard since 2018.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Low Yen Ling)
sentences.text: As a result of these engagements, ARH has expanded its range of talks and clinics to provide more targeted information and support for freelancers as suggested by Ms Tan.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Low Yen Ling)
sentences.text: These include sessions on how to leverage digitalisation tools such as augmented and virtual reality, and copyrights and intellectual property in the digital realm.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Low Yen Ling)
sentences.text: I wish to assure Ms Carrie Tan and the House that MCCY and NAC are fully and wholeheartedly committed to ensuring good work opportunities for our practitioners and freelancers.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Low Yen Ling)
sentences.text: Our national cultural institutions have adopted the Tripartite Standard on Contracting with self-employed persons since 2018 and we encourage all other arts organisations to do so.

sections.label: Partnership and public support for arts
sections.summary: A healthy partnership between Government, private and people sectors can pull Singapore through the crisis, and Singaporeans are urged to support artists' talents, productions and programmes, including freelancers.

sentences.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
sentences.text: A healthy partnership between Government, private and people sectors can pull us through this crisis and ensure that our arts and culture eco-system emerge stronger from COVID-19.

sentences.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
sentences.text: I want to welcome and also urge Singaporeans to continue to support the talents and the productions and the programmes of our artists, which included the freelancers.

sentences.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
sentences.text: As we do so, our demand creates work opportunities for this valuable sector and we also make the appreciation of arts and culture an integral part of our lives.
